newsitem.title: FRANCE: Tchuruk wants more details on GEC Alsthom plan.
newsitem.headline: Tchuruk wants more details on GEC Alsthom plan.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk said on Tuesday that he wanted to see a detailed analysis of proposals by General Electric Co Plc before deciding on the future of their GEC Alsthom joint-venture.
"For the moment I have no comment to make until I have seen a more detailed analysis of the outlines that have been announced (by GEC managing director George Simpson)," he told Reuters.
Tchuruk was at the French National Assembly for a closed-door hearing with the defence commission.
He said that he wanted "to see with care what George Simpson said. I am going to see in what condition he has been speaking."
Simpson said in an interview with Reuters in London that a flotation of GEC Alsthom on the London and Paris stock exchanges was possible.
Earlier he said in a statement that the group was talking with Alcatel about the future of GEC Alsthom, a fact Tchuruk himself had mentioned earlier this year.
